newsitem.title: USA: EPA increases Smith Environmental contract.
newsitem.headline: EPA increases Smith Environmental contract.

text.p: Smith Environmental Technologies Corp said Wednesday that the Environmental Protection Agency had increased its contract for emergency clean up services.
The value of the contract has been increased from $5.8 million to $17.7 million through November 3.
Under the contract, Smith Environmental provides the EPA with labor, materials, equipment and subcontractor resources for emergency response and cleanups at hazardous-waste sites.
The company, whose name changes to Smith Technology Corp at the end of the month, was awarded the contract in 1991.
